text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle sprinted her way through her 
first three years in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The numerous miracles achieved. While some 
things have changed because of them...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, why do I have to study for tests 
again after working so hard in the race~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, wouldn't it be nice to get a 
little exemption or something? Kinda feels 
unfair, y'know~

text_block_list.name: Cynical Umamusume
text_block_list.text: If anything, that makes it fair.

text_block_list.name: Cynical Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Racing is racing, and academics are 
academics. That's the Tracen Academy 
policy, after all."

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mirako~ You've improved so much at 
running, but your grades haven't changed 
one bit, have they~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hauu~, don't say that~. It's not like my 
brain can suddenly work that much faster.

text_block_list.name: Cynical Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it actually getting worse at this 
point?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So mean~! I told you, I haven't~! Even 
with how busy I've been, I've still been 
studying hard to keep my grades up~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Life at Tracen Academy hadn't changed in 
the slightest from before.

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Still~, who would've thought Mira-ko 
would become a GⅠ Umamusume, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, about that... I'm the one who feels 
that way the most.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I used to joke about being a future GⅠ 
Umamusume, but to think she actually had 
this kind of talent...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Mm, wait. Did I really have talent?

text_block_list.name: Cynical Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Was there none?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Man, whether someone has talent or not, or 
how hard they work... in the end, you just 
never really know, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: All of us are...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I guess nobody really understands 
themselves on their own.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's the same no matter who looks at it. 
No one has an answer or anything like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So, you know. Instead of overthinking it, 
we just gotta do it. We won't realize 
anything until we try.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: That's about all I can say.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufuun, so? Think a little better of me 
now?

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I see... But hey, Mirako, you're acting 
awfully high and mighty for someone who...

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You only realized it because Trainer kept 
pushing you, right? It's not like you did 
it on your own, did you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Gulp... Well, yeah... Guess I was just 
lucky, huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
First, nothing can begin unless there's 
someone out there who thinks, "Maybe 
there's something to this."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It just means I had someone special like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oho, bragging about your love life, are 
we~? Look at you go, ooh la la~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not it~, I'm not bragging 
about my love life~. I'm totally serious.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because there really, truly was someone 
like that...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's from Trainer! Oh right, it's 
already time for training...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Sorry, well, see ya later.

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Aaaalright, best of luck~. Wishing you all 
the happiness.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(That's right, there are people who 
believe in me. So...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Let's do my best today too. Just a tiny 
bit beyond what I think my limit is.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wait, all of this~?! Isn't this way too 
much~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can do all this~.
choice_data_list: You can do it! I'm counting on you!
You can do it! I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: That again~? You're so mean, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I'll do it, I really will, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Once I see it through, you have to praise 
me tons, okay? And buy me a juice too, 
please.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Heaaave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even while grumbling, Hishi Miracle dashed 
off looking somehow happy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"An unchanging everyday life. But right 
here, life feels just a little bit more 
fulfilling than before."
